newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent pushed higher by NYMEX heating oil.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent pushed higher by NYMEX heating oil.

text.p: IPE Brent futures rose to session highs on the back of NYMEX heating oil breaching 72.25 cents a gallon, its highest level in five years.
"It's all looking a lot stronger on the technicals," said one IPE trader.
November Brent was trading at $23.36 a barrel at 1514 GMT, up 16 cents, having broken through first resistance of $23.32 (yesterday's high). Secondary resistance was pegged at $23.80 and then $24.00.
October gas oil was at $231.50 a tonne at 1509 GMT, up $6.50, having encountered and beaten strong selling pressure at $230.00.
The market is firmly focussed on breaking $235.00, the high since August 1991.
